name: herdr config
description: Runs the herdr-config installer (github.com/elvisgastelum/herdr-config; the script is pinned to a commit, but it has no ref option and downloads its files from main) when `herdr-config` is not installed. It writes OUTSIDE the Claude dir: ~/.config/herdr, ~/.local/bin/herdr-config and ~/.agents/skills/herdr-config. Needs curl.
